| [`SV-PRF-009`](../../testdata/rules/performance/SV-PRF-009) | NbaOnClassProperty | WARNING | performance |  | Disallow non-blocking assignments ('<=') on class properties. For heap-allocated class instances, NBAs force the simulator kernel to create dynamic event descriptors in the NBA region of the event wheel. Use blocking assignment ('='). |
| [`SV-PRF-010`](../../testdata/rules/performance/SV-PRF-010) | StringConcatInLoop | WARNING | performance |  | Disallows iterative in-place string concatenation or $sformatf recursion inside loop bodies to prevent O(N^2) memory reallocation overhead. |
| [`SV-PRF-011`](../../testdata/rules/performance/SV-PRF-011) | DynamicArrayNewInLoop | WARNING | performance |  | Disallows dynamic array allocation (new[...]) inside simulation loops to prevent heap contention and memory churn. |
| [`SV-PRF-012`](../../testdata/rules/performance/SV-PRF-012) | UnboundedDynamicArrayInConstraint | WARNING | performance |  | Flags dynamic array or queue size constraints with an upper bound (< or <=) lacking an explicit lower bound. |
| [`SV-PRF-013`](../../testdata/rules/performance/SV-PRF-013) | ForkInClockedLoop | WARNING | performance |  | Flags fork/join, join_any, and join_none inside a clocked loop (always_ff, always @(posedge/negedge), or a loop that waits on a clock edge). A thread started on every clock piles work onto the scheduler. |

## Portability

| ID | Name | Severity | Profiles | Guidelines | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| [`PORT-PRP-001`](../../testdata/rules/portability/PORT-PRP-001) | ProprietaryVendorCalls | WARNING | soundness, security | MG-4.3 | Disallow unguarded simulator-proprietary system tasks ($vcdpluson, $fsdbDumpvars, $shm_open). Vendor-specific calls prevent Verification IP from running on other simulators. |
| [`PORT-PTH-001`](../../testdata/rules/portability/PORT-PTH-001) | HardcodedHostPaths | ERROR | soundness, security | MG-4.3 | Disallow hardcoded absolute filesystem paths (/home/..., C:\...) in file operations ($readmemh, $fopen). Absolute paths break regression execution in containerized CI/CD pipelines. |
| `SV-MAC-001` | HeaderMacroLeak | WARNING | methodology, style | MG-1.3 | Macros defined inside header files (.svh) must be undef'd with `undef before the end of the file unless registered as public API macros. Leaking macros causes silent parameter overrides and compilation collisions. |
| [`SV-MOD-001`](../../testdata/rules/portability/SV-MOD-001) | GlobalUnitPollution | ERROR | soundness | MG-1.3 | Disallow variables, nets, typedefs, tasks, and functions declared directly in the $unit compilation unit scope. Declarations outside a package or module cause cross-file namespace pollution and compile-order dependencies in multi-unit compilation. |
| [`UVM-API-001`](../../testdata/rules/uvm/UVM-API-001) | AccelleraOnlyApi | INFO | soundness, security |  | Flags calls to, and classes extending, parts of the Accellera UVM library that IEEE 1800.2 does not define (tagged @uvm-accellera in the library source), such as uvm_component::print_config or uvm_port_base::debug_connected_to. Code that relies on them is tied to one UVM implementation and release. The list comes from the UVM API pack of the version being compiled. |

| [`SV-STY-002`](../../testdata/rules/style/SV-STY-002) | MacroTrailingSemicolon | WARNING | style |  | Flags unnecessary semicolons following `uvm_* macro invocations that create empty statements in declarative or procedural scopes. |
| [`SV-STY-003`](../../testdata/rules/style/SV-STY-003) | TodoCommentTracker | INFO | style |  | Tracks unresolved TODO, FIXME, ICEBOX, HACK, and XXX comment markers across the codebase. Ensures temporary developer placeholders are addressed before tape-out or milestone delivery. |
| [`SV-STY-004`](../../testdata/rules/style/SV-STY-004) | TypedefNameSuffix | WARNING | style |  | Enforces naming conventions for typedefs: enums must end with '_e', and structs/data types must end with '_t'. |
| `SV-STY-005` | MandatoryMatchingEndLabel | INFO | style |  | Enforces explicit and matching end labels on functions, tasks, and classes (e.g., endfunction : name). Prevents scope delimiter ambiguity in large verification codebases. |
| [`SV-STY-006`](../../testdata/rules/style/SV-STY-006) | MismatchedEndLabel | WARNING | style |  | Flags mismatched end labels on functions, tasks, and classes (e.g., function void foo(); ... endfunction : bar). Prevents scope delimiter confusion and copy-paste errors. |
| [`SV-STY-007`](../../testdata/rules/documentation/SV-STY-007) | MethodBannerStyle | INFO | style |  | Standardizes method separator pre-banners. Enforces 70–80 character uniform dashed separator lines and flags ragged or arbitrary-width comment separators. |
| [`SV-STY-008`](../../testdata/rules/documentation/SV-STY-008) | SectionHeaderBanner | INFO | style |  | Standardizes major section divider banners to uniform 70–80 character widths. Prevents ragged ASCII banners across verification packages and testbench files. |
| [`SV-STY-010`](../../testdata/rules/safety/SV-STY-010) | ExplicitLiteralWidth | WARNING | style |  | Disallow unsized integer and numeric literals without explicit bit-width declarations. Prevents silent 32-bit zero-extension and sign extension bugs. |
| [`SV-STY-011`](../../testdata/rules/style/SV-STY-011) | OneStatementPerLine | WARNING | style |  | Prohibit multiple procedural statements on the same line separated by semicolons. Enforces clean formatting and deterministic single-stepping in simulation debuggers. |
| [`SV-STY-012`](../../testdata/rules/style/SV-STY-012) | SpaceKeywordParen | INFO | style |  | Requires a single space between control keywords (if, for, foreach, while, case) and opening parenthesis. Enforces common SystemVerilog code formatting guidelines. |
| `SV-STY-013` | IncludeGuard | ERROR | style | MG-1.3 | Every included header file (.svh) must be wrapped in standard macro include guards (`ifndef / `define / `endif) to prevent circular definitions and compiler redefinition errors. |
| [`SV-STY-015`](../../testdata/rules/style/SV-STY-015) | TrailingWhitespace | INFO | style |  | Disallows trailing whitespace (spaces and tabs) at the end of lines in source files. |
| [`SV-STY-016`](../../testdata/rules/style/SV-STY-016) | MaxLineLength | INFO | style |  | Flags source lines exceeding 120 characters (option: max_columns) to preserve readability across split-view editors and terminal reviews. |

| `SV-STY-103` | MaxLineLength | WARNING | style |  | Lines must not exceed style.max_line_length characters. (reported by `SV-STY-100`) |
| `SV-STY-104` | MatchingEndLabel | WARNING | style |  | Blocks, routines and classes carry an end label that matches their name (style.mandatory_matching_end_label). (reported by `SV-STY-100`) |

| `UVM-NAM-103` | UvmSequencerNaming | WARNING | style |  | UVM sequencers must end with '_sequencer' or '_sqr'. (reported by `SV-NAM-100`) |

| `UVM-NAM-105` | UvmSequenceItemNaming | WARNING | style |  | UVM transaction/sequence items must end with '_item' or '_seq_item'. (reported by `SV-NAM-100`) |
| `UVM-NAM-106` | UvmAgentNaming | WARNING | style |  | UVM agents must end with '_agent' suffix. (reported by `SV-NAM-100`) |
| `UVM-NAM-107` | UvmEnvNaming | WARNING | style |  | UVM environments must end with '_env' suffix. (reported by `SV-NAM-100`) |

## Maintainability

| ID | Name | Severity | Profiles | Guidelines | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| [`SV-API-001`](../../testdata/rules/readability/SV-API-001) | RefArgumentNeverWritten | INFO | smells | MG-9.1 | Flags ref arguments that the routine only reads; declare them const ref so callers know they are not modified (clang-tidy readability-non-const-parameter). Virtual methods are skipped because overrides share the signature. |
| [`SV-CNS-001`](../../testdata/rules/methodology/SV-CNS-001) | DefineForConstant | WARNING | smells | MG-6.1 | Flags `define macros whose body is only a number or a string, used as constants. A package parameter or localparam has a type and a scope; a macro is global to the rest of the compilation and can be redefined silently (MG-6.1). |
| [`SV-CNS-003`](../../testdata/rules/methodology/SV-CNS-003) | IfdefInReusableClass | WARNING | smells | MG-6.1 | Flags `ifdef, `ifndef and `elsif inside class bodies, apart from simulator and UVM version shims. Compile-time switches multiply the variants of a class and cannot be chosen per instance; configuration can (MG-6.1). |
| [`SV-CNS-004`](../../testdata/rules/methodology/SV-CNS-004) | StringAsEnum | WARNING | smells | MG-6.2 | Flags a string variable compared against three or more literals in one case statement or if/else-if chain. The values form an enumeration the compiler cannot check; a typo in any of them fails silently (Fowler 'primitive obsession', MG-6.2). String arguments are SV-CPL-001's. |
| [`SV-CPL-001`](../../testdata/rules/methodology/SV-CPL-001) | StringModeParameter | WARNING | smells | MG-2.4 | Flags routines whose string argument is compared against two or more literals to choose what to do, as in do_op("read"). Caller and callee must agree on spellings the compiler never checks (control coupling, connascence of meaning, MG-2.4). Use an enum argument or separate routines. Overrides are left alone. |
| [`SV-DED-013`](../../testdata/rules/deadcode/SV-DED-013) | UnusedRoutineArgument | INFO | smells | MG-9.1 | Flags task and function arguments that the body never uses (clang-tidy misc-unused-parameters, Pylint W0613). Virtual methods and overrides, phase methods, DPI routines and empty bodies are skipped. |
| [`SV-DED-014`](../../testdata/rules/deadcode/SV-DED-014) | UnusedLocalMethod | WARNING | smells | MG-9.1 | Flags a local task or function that no method of its class calls. A local method is invisible outside the class, so with no caller it is dead. |
| [`SV-DSN-002`](../../testdata/rules/design/SV-DSN-002) | GodClass | WARNING | smells | MG-3.1 | Flags classes that are very complex (WMC >= 47), use many other classes' data (ATFD > 5) and have low cohesion (TCC < 1/3): PMD's GodClass detection strategy. |
| [`SV-DSN-003`](../../testdata/rules/design/SV-DSN-003) | LowCohesion | INFO | smells | MG-3.1 | Flags classes whose methods split into two or more groups that share no fields and do not call each other (LCOM4 > 1): the class is really several classes. |
| [`SV-DSN-004`](../../testdata/rules/design/SV-DSN-004) | HighCoupling | INFO | smells | MG-2.1 | Flags classes other than envs and tests that reference more than 10 distinct user class types (CK coupling between objects, PMD CouplingBetweenObjects). |
| [`SV-DSN-005`](../../testdata/rules/design/SV-DSN-005) | DeepInheritance | INFO | smells |  | Flags classes with more than 3 user-defined ancestors above the UVM base class (CK depth of inheritance tree, Pylint too-many-ancestors). |
| [`SV-DSN-006`](../../testdata/rules/design/SV-DSN-006) | OverrideOnlyCallsSuper | INFO | smells | MG-5.2 | Flags overrides whose whole body is the super call with the same arguments, such as a connect_phase that only calls super.connect_phase(phase) (Pylint useless-parent-delegation, Sonar S1185). Constructors are kept. |
| [`SV-DSN-007`](../../testdata/rules/design/SV-DSN-007) | EmptyOverrideOfConcrete | WARNING | smells | MG-5.2 | Flags an empty override of a user base-class method that has a body, which silently switches the inherited behavior off (Fowler 'refused bequest', Liskov substitution). |
| [`SV-DSN-013`](../../testdata/rules/design/SV-DSN-013) | FatalStubOverride | WARNING | smells |  | Flags an override of a user base-class method whose whole body is an error or fatal report ("not supported here"). The subclass refuses part of its parent's contract, so code holding a base handle fails at run time (Fowler 'refused bequest'). Split the base class instead. SV-DSN-007 covers empty overrides. |
| [`SV-DUP-001`](../../testdata/rules/oop/SV-DUP-001) | DuplicateMethodBody | WARNING | smells | MG-7.1 | Detects identical or copy-pasted subroutine method bodies across different classes. Duplicated code should be refactored into shared base classes or utilities. |
| [`SV-DUP-002`](../../testdata/rules/methodology/SV-DUP-002) | CloneFragments | WARNING | smells | MG-7.1 | Finds runs of three or more statements (at least 50 tokens) that appear in more than one place, also when variables and literals were renamed consistently. Macro calls count as written, not as their expansion, and called names must match; runs that repeat one short cycle of statements, like unrolled loops, are left out. Each pair of routines is reported once; whole identical method bodies are SV-DUP-001's, and files whose header says they are generated are left out (DRY, Type-1/2 clones, MG-7.1). |
| [`SV-DUP-003`](../../testdata/rules/methodology/SV-DUP-003) | DuplicatedConstraint | WARNING | smells | MG-7.1 | Flags a constraint body repeated in two classes that do not inherit from each other. The rule then lives in two places and drifts; declare it once in a shared base class or a policy object (Fowler 'pull up', MG-7.1). SV-RND-011 covers repeats inside one class. |
| [`SV-MET-001`](../../testdata/rules/metrics/SV-MET-001) | CognitiveComplexity | WARNING | smells | MG-9.1 | Flags routines whose Sonar cognitive complexity (nesting-weighted branching, with fork/join counted as nesting) exceeds the threshold (default 25; Sonar S3776). |
| [`SV-MET-002`](../../testdata/rules/metrics/SV-MET-002) | LongRoutine | WARNING | smells | MG-9.1 | Flags routines with more statements than the threshold (default 100; clang-tidy readability-function-size, Checkstyle MethodLength). |
| [`SV-MET-003`](../../testdata/rules/metrics/SV-MET-003) | TooManyArguments | WARNING | smells | MG-9.1 | Flags tasks and functions with more formal arguments than the threshold (default 7; Pylint R0913, Sonar S107). Overrides are judged at the base declaration only. |
| [`SV-MET-004`](../../testdata/rules/metrics/SV-MET-004) | DeepNesting | WARNING | smells | MG-9.1 | Flags routines whose control structures nest deeper than the threshold (default 5; Checkstyle NestedIfDepth, clang-tidy readability-function-size NestingThreshold). |
| [`SV-MET-005`](../../testdata/rules/metrics/SV-MET-005) | ComplexCondition | WARNING | smells | MG-9.1 | Flags conditions with more && / \|\| operators than the threshold (default 5; Pylint R0916, Checkstyle BooleanExpressionComplexity). |
| [`SV-MET-006`](../../testdata/rules/metrics/SV-MET-006) | LargeClass | INFO | smells | MG-3.1 | Flags classes with more than 30 properties or 30 methods; config objects and sequence items may have 80 properties, register models are exempt (PMD TooManyFields and TooManyMethods, Pylint R0902/R0904). |
| [`SV-MET-007`](../../testdata/rules/metrics/SV-MET-007) | LongTask | WARNING | smells | MG-9.1 | Flags tasks longer than the line budget (default 40 source lines, option max_lines). A long task is hard to review and to cover; split it into named tasks with one job each. |
| [`SV-MET-008`](../../testdata/rules/metrics/SV-MET-008) | RandFieldBudget | WARNING | smells | MG-9.1 | Flags a sequence item that declares more than the rand-field budget (default 8, option max_rand), counting rand and randc properties of the class itself. A wide item is slow to solve and hard to constrain; split the fields across items. |
| [`SV-RDB-001`](../../testdata/rules/readability/SV-RDB-001) | PositionalFlagLiterals | INFO | smells | MG-2.4 | Flags calls that pass two or more 0/1 literals positionally to 1-bit arguments; use named argument binding (clang-tidy bugprone-argument-comment, Clean Code flag arguments). |
| [`SV-SML-001`](../../testdata/rules/smells/SV-SML-001) | ScratchpadClassProperty | WARNING | smells |  | Disallow declaring scratchpad variables or loop induction counters as class properties. Move declarations to method stack frames to ensure thread safety and re-entrancy. |
| [`SV-SML-002`](../../testdata/rules/smells/SV-SML-002) | MagicDelayInSequence | WARNING | smells |  | Disallow hardcoded physical delays (#delay) inside uvm_sequence. Sequences must be clocking-block and frequency agnostic. |
| [`SV-SML-003`](../../testdata/rules/smells/SV-SML-003) | GenericReportId | INFO | smells |  | Disallow generic single-word report IDs ('ERR', 'INFO', 'DEBUG') in UVM reporting macros. Use feature-scoped hierarchical identifiers to support precise log filtering. |
| [`SV-SML-004`](../../testdata/rules/smells/SV-SML-004) | CyclomaticComplexityGodMethod | WARNING | smells | MG-9.1 | Detects subroutines with high McCabe Cyclomatic Complexity ($M > 15$). Complex control flow obscures edge cases and inhibits functional verification. |

## Advisory

| ID | Name | Severity | Profiles | Guidelines | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| [`SV-CNS-002`](../../testdata/rules/methodology/SV-CNS-002) | MacroAsRoutine | INFO | advisory | MG-6.1 | Flags multi-statement code macros that use nothing only a macro can do: no token pasting, stringification, nested macros, `__FILE__, type arguments, declarations or return/break. A function or task would be type-checked and debuggable (MG-6.1). Advisory: off by default. |
| [`SV-CNS-005`](../../testdata/rules/methodology/SV-CNS-005) | ManualBitFieldSlicing | INFO | advisory | MG-6.2 | Flags a vector that is cut into three or more different fixed part-selects (hdr[7:0], hdr[15:8], hdr[31:16]). The field layout lives in scattered numbers; a packed struct names it once (MG-6.2). Advisory: off by default. |
| [`SV-CNS-006`](../../testdata/rules/methodology/SV-CNS-006) | ImplicitEnumBaseType | INFO | advisory | MG-6.3 | Flags enums in packages, classes and interfaces declared without a base type. They silently become 32-bit int, which wastes bits in packed items and no longer matches the width of the bus field they model (MG-6.3). Advisory: off by default. |
| [`SV-CNS-007`](../../testdata/rules/methodology/SV-CNS-007) | LegacyIntegerType | INFO | advisory | MG-6.3 | Flags the Verilog-1995 type 'integer' in class code. It is a 4-state 32-bit signed value; int (2-state) or an explicitly sized logic vector says what is meant (MG-6.3). Advisory: off by default. |
| [`SV-CNS-008`](../../testdata/rules/methodology/SV-CNS-008) | FunctionOutputArguments | INFO | advisory | MG-6.3 | Flags void class functions that hand their results back through output arguments. A return value, or a struct for several values, keeps the call an expression and makes the data flow visible (command-query separation, MG-6.3). Overrides are left alone, since their signature is fixed. Advisory: off by default. |
| [`SV-DBC-001`](../../testdata/rules/methodology/SV-DBC-001) | InterfaceWithoutAssertions | INFO | advisory | MG-8.2 | Flags an interface with clocking blocks or modports, so a protocol interface, that holds no assertions (assert/assume/cover property, immediate asserts, property declarations or checkers) and is not the target of a bind. Every bench that reuses it then re-checks the protocol by hand, or not at all (design by contract; MG-8.2). Advisory: off by default. |
| [`SV-DED-015`](../../testdata/rules/deadcode/SV-DED-015) | NeverSetClassParameter | INFO | advisory |  | Flags a parameter of a user parameterized class that no specialization in the linted design ever sets. The class claims a flexibility nobody uses or verifies (Fowler 'speculative generality'); make it a localparam or drop it. Whole-program: a specialization in a file that was not linted is not seen, and only specializations used as a class member or base class are counted. Advisory: off by default. |
| [`SV-DSN-009`](../../testdata/rules/design/SV-DSN-009) | RepeatedEnumSwitch | INFO | advisory | MG-5.2 | Flags an enum that is switched on with case in three or more classes, a sign that behavior per kind belongs in a polymorphic item or policy class (Fowler 'repeated switches'). Advisory: off by default. |
| [`SV-DSN-010`](../../testdata/rules/design/SV-DSN-010) | QueryChangesState | INFO | advisory |  | Flags functions named get_*, is_* or has_* that write class properties (command-query separation). get_next_* is allowed. Advisory: off by default. |
| [`SV-DSN-011`](../../testdata/rules/methodology/SV-DSN-011) | FeatureEnvy | INFO | advisory | MG-3.1 | Flags a method that uses one other object's fields at least 6 times (option min_foreign) and more than twice as often as its own class's fields. The logic belongs with the data it uses (Fowler: Feature Envy; MG-3.1). Transactions, config objects, the same class and classes in the same hierarchy do not count, nor do copy/compare/print and build/connect methods. Advisory: off by default. |
| [`SV-DSN-012`](../../testdata/rules/design/SV-DSN-012) | PrimitiveObsession | INFO | advisory |  | Flags a rand integral field of a sequence item or config that a constraint limits to a list of 3 to 16 single constant values ('x inside {0, 1, 2}'). The field is an enumeration: as an enum it prints by name in logs and waveforms and the compiler checks every value. Advisory: off by default. |
| [`SV-DUP-004`](../../testdata/rules/methodology/SV-DUP-004) | RepeatedStringLiteral | INFO | advisory | MG-7.1 | Flags a string literal, such as a report ID or a file name, written four or more times in the code. Config keys (UVM-CFG-008), instance names and class names are left out. One named constant keeps the copies in step (DRY, MG-7.1). Advisory: off by default. |
| [`SV-DUP-005`](../../testdata/rules/methodology/SV-DUP-005) | CopiedAgentPackage | INFO | advisory | MG-7.2 | Flags two packages whose classes have the same roles, fields and method bodies apart from renamed identifiers, for at least three classes and 80% of the classes in the larger package (classes with almost no code are not counted). They are one agent copied and renamed; a parameterized agent, or a shared base with small subclasses, keeps one copy to fix (DRY, MG-7.2). Advisory: off by default. |
| [`SV-DUP-006`](../../testdata/rules/design/SV-DUP-006) | DataClumps | INFO | advisory |  | Flags the same group of min_args (default 4) or more arguments (same names and types) declared by min_routines (default 3) or more routines. Values that always travel together belong in a transaction or struct; passing them one by one lets two same-typed arguments be swapped silently (Fowler 'data clumps'). Overrides are counted once, at the base declaration; each group is reported once, at its first routine. Advisory: off by default. |
| `SV-EVO-001` | Hotspot | INFO | advisory | MG-9.2 | With --history: reports the files that are both complex (summed cyclomatic complexity of their routines) and often changed in git, the top five by complexity times commits. Such hotspots are where defects collect and where refactoring pays first (Tornhill, MG-9.2). Advisory: off by default. |
| `SV-EVO-002` | ChangeCoupling | INFO | advisory | MG-9.2 | With --history: reports two files in different packages that change together in at least three commits and in at least half of the commits touching either. The packages have a hidden dependency that their imports do not show; move the shared knowledge to one place (temporal coupling, MG-9.2). Advisory: off by default. |
| [`SV-MET-009`](../../testdata/rules/metrics/SV-MET-009) | ConfigKnobBudget | WARNING | advisory |  | Flags a configuration object (a uvm_object named *cfg* or *config*) that declares more than max_knobs (default 12) data members of its own. Split it into per-agent or per-feature sub-configs that the parent config holds. Advisory: SV-MET-006 already allows config objects up to 80 fields, so this stricter budget is opt-in. |
| [`SV-PKG-005`](../../testdata/rules/methodology/SV-PKG-005) | UnstablePackageDependedOn | INFO | advisory | MG-1.4 | Computes instability I = Ce / (Ca + Ce) for each user package from its imports and flags a package that depends on a less stable one. Many packages rely on a stable package, so its own dependencies should be at least as stable (Martin's stable dependencies principle, MG-1.4). Advisory: off by default. |
| [`SV-RDB-002`](../../testdata/rules/readability/SV-RDB-002) | MagicNumber | INFO | advisory | MG-9.1 | Flags numeric literals other than 0, 1 and -1 in class method bodies: conditions, loop bounds and sizes; delays are left to the magic-delay rules (Checkstyle MagicNumber, Sonar S109). Advisory: off by default. |
| [`SV-RDB-003`](../../testdata/rules/readability/SV-RDB-003) | CommentedOutCode | INFO | advisory | MG-9.1 | Flags blocks of // comments that parse as SystemVerilog statements or declarations (Sonar S125). Advisory: off by default. |
| [`SV-RDB-004`](../../testdata/rules/readability/SV-RDB-004) | UndocumentedExtensionPoint | INFO | advisory | MG-5.2 | Flags new virtual methods without a preceding comment in classes meant to be extended: classes with user subclasses, classes named *base*, and callbacks (Checkstyle MissingJavadocMethod, Pylint C0116). Advisory: off by default. |
| [`SV-RDB-005`](../../testdata/rules/readability/SV-RDB-005) | RedundantBoolean | INFO | advisory | MG-9.1 | Flags 1-bit values compared with 1'b1/1'b0 and 'if (c) return 1; else return 0;' (Sonar S1125, clang-tidy readability-simplify-boolean-expr). Advisory: off by default. |
| [`SV-RDB-006`](../../testdata/rules/readability/SV-RDB-006) | DoubleNegativeFlag | INFO | advisory |  | Flags '!' (or '~' on one bit) applied to a variable whose name is negative (disable_*, no_*, not_*, skip_*, inhibit_*, ...). Advisory: off by default. |
| [`SV-RDB-007`](../../testdata/rules/readability/SV-RDB-007) | NonDescriptiveName | INFO | advisory |  | Flags class properties, and locals of routines longer than min_lines (default 10), named tmp, temp, val, obj, foo, d, t and the like (with or without a number; locals also data and value). Arguments and loop variables are not checked. Advisory: off by default. |
| [`SV-RDB-008`](../../testdata/rules/readability/SV-RDB-008) | UnclearAbbreviation | INFO | advisory |  | Flags class, property, method and local names containing a vowel-less word of four or more letters (trnsfr, chnnl, rgstr) that is not a common DV short form (clk, cfg, ctrl, jtag, ...). Each person drops different vowels, so such names defeat grep. Advisory: off by default. |
| [`SV-RDB-009`](../../testdata/rules/readability/SV-RDB-009) | RedundantComment | INFO | advisory |  | Flags a one-line // comment directly above a statement when every word of the comment (2 to 6 words, ignoring a, the, to, ...) is already a word of the statement's names, e.g. '// set cfg' above set_cfg(). Advisory: off by default. |
| [`SV-RDB-010`](../../testdata/rules/readability/SV-RDB-010) | UndocumentedTestbenchClass | INFO | advisory |  | Flags UVM components and sequences without a comment of at least min_words (default 10) words of prose right above the class. Copyright and license lines do not count. Advisory: off by default. |
| [`SV-SVA-006`](../../testdata/rules/sva/SV-SVA-006) | ComplexInlineProperty | INFO | advisory |  | Flags assert/assume/cover property statements whose inline property uses more than max_temporal_ops (default 3) temporal operators (##, \|->, \|=>, [*], throughout, within, until, ...). Advisory: off by default. |
| [`SV-TST-001`](../../testdata/rules/random/SV-TST-001) | ConstantReseed | INFO | advisory |  | Flags srandom() or set_randstate() with a constant in components, sequences and other non-test classes; every seed of the regression then runs the same stimulus. Advisory: off by default. |
| [`UVM-PAT-003`](../../testdata/rules/methodology/UVM-PAT-003) | NoExtensionPoint | INFO | advisory | MG-5.2 | Flags a driver or monitor whose run_phase is long (25 statements or more; option min_statements) while the class and its user bases declare no virtual hook methods and use no callbacks. A test or derived agent cannot then change one step, such as error injection or timing, without copying the whole run_phase (MG-5.2). Advisory: off by default. |
| [`UVM-ROL-007`](../../testdata/rules/methodology/UVM-ROL-007) | ProceduralTimeoutInMonitor | INFO | advisory |  | Flags fork ... join_any blocks in a monitor where one branch counts clock cycles (repeat (N) @(...)) and then reports an error: a handshake timeout written as procedural code. A concurrent assertion in the interface states the same rule in one line and checks it every cycle. Advisory: off by default. |
